1.text: Now after tha death of Moses tha servant of tha LORD it happened, dat tha LORD spoke 2 Joshua tha son of Nun, Moses’ minister, sayin,
Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over dis Jordan, u, N all dis people, 2 tha land which I do give 2 ’em, even 2 tha children of Israel.
Every place dat tha sole of ur foot shall tread upon, dat have I given 2 u, as I said 2 Moses.
From tha wilderness N dis Lebanon even 2 tha great river, tha river Euphrates, all tha land of tha Hittites, N 2 tha great sea toward tha goin down of tha sun, shall be ur coast.
There shall not any man be able 2 stand before u all tha days of ur life: as I was wit Moses, so I will be wit u: I will not fail u, nor forsake u.
Be strong N of a good courage: 4 2 dis people will u divide 4 an inheritance tha land, which I sware 2 their fathers 2 give ’em.

Only be u strong N very courageous, dat u may observe 2 do according 2 all tha law, which Moses my servant commanded u: turn not from it 2 tha right hand or 2 tha left, dat u may prosper wherever u go.

Dis book of tha law shall not depart out of ur mouth; but u will meditate in it day N night, dat u may observe 2 do according 2 all dat is written in it: 4 then u will make ur way prosperous, N then u will have good success.
Have not I commanded u? Be strong N of a good courage; don’t be afraid, neither be u dismayed: 4 tha LORD ur God is wit u wherever u go.
Then Joshua commanded tha officers of tha people, sayin,
Pass through tha host, N command tha people, sayin, Prepare u food; 4 within three days y’all shall pass over dis Jordan, 2 go in 2 possess tha land, which tha LORD ur God gives u 2 possess it.
N 2 tha Reubenites, N 2 tha Gadites, N 2 half tha tribe of Manasseh, spoke Joshua, sayin,
Remember tha word which Moses tha servant of tha LORD commanded u, sayin, tha LORD ur God has given u rest, N has given u dis land.
Ur wives, ur little ones, N ur cattle, shall remain in tha land which Moses gave u on dis side Jordan; but y’all shall pass before ur brothers armed, all tha mighty men of valour, N help ’em;

Until tha LORD have given ur brothers rest, as he has given u, N dey also have possessed tha land which tha LORD ur God gives ’em: then y’all shall return 2 tha land of ur possession, N enjoy it, which Moses tha LORD’s servant gave u on dis side Jordan toward tha sunrising.
N dey answered Joshua, sayin, All dat u command us we will do, N wherever u send us, we will go.
According as we listened 2 Moses in all things, so will we listen 2 u: only tha LORD ur God be wit u, as he was wit Moses.
Whoever he be dat does rebel against ur commandment, N will not listen 2 ur words in all dat u command him, he shall be put 2 death: only be strong N of a good courage.

2.text: N Joshua tha son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men 2 spy secretly, sayin, Go view tha land, even Jericho. N dey went, N came in2 an harlot’s house, named Rahab, N lodged there.
N it was told tha king of Jericho, sayin, look, there came men in here 2 night of tha children of Israel 2 search out tha country.
N tha king of Jericho sent 2 Rahab, sayin, Bring forth tha men dat r come 2 u, which r entered in2 thine house: 4 dey be come 2 search out all tha country.
N tha woman took tha two men, N hid ’em, N said like dis, There came men 2 me, but I knew not from where dey were:
N it happened about tha time of shutting of tha gate, when it was dark, dat tha men went out: where tha men went I know not: pursue after ’em quickly; 4 y’all shall overtake ’em.
But she had brought ’em up 2 tha roof of tha house, N hid ’em wit tha stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon tha roof.
N tha men pursued after ’em tha way 2 Jordan 2 tha fords: N as soon as dey which pursued after ’em were gone out, dey shut tha gate.
N before dey were laid down, she came up 2 ’em upon tha roof;
N she said 2 tha men, I know dat tha LORD has given u tha land, N dat ur terror is fallen upon us, N dat all tha inhabitants of tha land faint because of u.

4 we have heard how tha LORD dried up tha water of tha Red sea 4 u, when y’all came out of Egypt; N what y’all did 2 tha two kings of tha Amorites, dat were on tha other side Jordan, Sihon N Og, whom y’all utterly destroyed.
N as soon as we had heard dese things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of u: 4 tha LORD ur God, he is God in heaven above, N in earth beneath.
Now therefore, I pray u, swear 2 me by tha LORD, since I have showed u kindness, dat y’all will also show kindness 2 my father’s house, N give me a true token:
N dat y’all will save alive my father, N my mother, N my brothers, N my sisters, N all dat dey have, N deliver our lives from death.
N tha men answered her, Our life 4 urz, if y’all utter not dis our business. N it will be, when tha LORD has given us tha land, dat we will deal kindly N truly wit u.
Then she let ’em down by a cord through tha window: 4 her house was upon tha town wall, N she lived upon tha wall.
N she said 2 ’em, Get u 2 tha mountain, lest tha pursuers meet u; N hide y’all there three days, until tha pursuers be returned: N afterward may y’all go ur way.
N tha men said 2 her, We will be blameless of dis thine oath which u have made us swear.

Look, when we come in2 tha land, u will bind dis line of scarlet thread in tha window which u did let us down by: N u will bring ur father, N ur mother, N ur brothers, N all ur father’s household, home 2 u.

N it will be, dat whoever shall go out of tha doors of ur house in2 tha street, his blood shall be upon his head, N we will be guiltless: N whoever shall be wit u in tha house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
N if u utter dis our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which u have made us 2 swear.
N she said, According 2 ur words, so be it. N she sent ’em away, N dey departed: N she bound tha scarlet line in tha window.
N dey went, N came 2 tha mountain, N stayed there three days, until tha pursuers were returned: N tha pursuers sought ’em throughout all tha way, but found ’em not.
So tha two men returned, N descended from tha mountain, N passed over, N came 2 Joshua tha son of Nun, N told him all things dat befell ’em:
N dey said 2 Joshua, Truly tha LORD has delivered in2 our hands all tha land; 4 even all tha inhabitants of tha country do faint because of us.

3.text: N Joshua rose early in tha morning; N dey removed from Shittim, N came 2 Jordan, he N all tha children of Israel, N lodged there before dey passed over.
N it happened after three days, dat tha officers went through tha host;
N dey commanded tha people, sayin, When y’all see tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD ur God, N tha priests tha Levites bearin it, then y’all shall remove from ur place, N go after it.
Yet there shall be a space between u N it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near 2 it, dat y’all may know tha way by which y’all must go: 4 y’all have not passed dis way before now.
N Joshua said 2 tha people, Sanctify y’all: 4 2 morrow tha LORD will do wonders among u.
N Joshua spoke 2 tha priests, sayin, Take up tha ark of tha covenant, N pass over before tha people. N dey took up tha ark of tha covenant, N went before tha people.
N tha LORD said 2 Joshua, dis day will I begin 2 magnify u in tha sight of all Israel, dat dey may know dat, as I was wit Moses, so I will be wit u.
N u will command tha priests dat bear tha ark of tha covenant, sayin, When y’all r come 2 tha brink of tha water of Jordan, y’all shall stand still in Jordan.
N Joshua said 2 tha children of Israel, Come here, N hear tha words of tha LORD ur God.

N Joshua said, by dis y’all shall know dat tha livin God is among u, N dat he will without fail drive out from before u tha Canaanites, N tha Hittites, N tha Hivites, N tha Perizzites, N tha Girgashites, N tha Amorites, N tha Jebusites.
Look, tha ark of tha covenant of tha Lord of all tha earth passes over before u in2 Jordan.
Now therefore take u twelve men out of tha tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

N it will happen, as soon as tha soles of tha feet of tha priests dat bear tha ark of tha LORD, tha Lord of all tha earth, shall rest in tha waterz of Jordan, dat tha waterz of Jordan shall be cut off from tha waterz dat come down from above; N dey shall stand upon an heap.
N it happened, when tha people removed from their tents, 2 pass over Jordan, N tha priests bearin tha ark of tha covenant before tha people;
N as dey dat bare tha ark were come 2 Jordan, N tha feet of tha priests dat bare tha ark were dipped in tha brim of tha water, (4 Jordan overfloweth all his banks all tha time of harvest,)

Dat tha waterz which came down from above stood N rose up upon an heap very far from tha city Adam, dat is beside Zaretan: N dose dat came down toward tha sea of tha plain, even tha salt sea, failed, N were cut off: N tha people passed over right against Jericho.

N tha priests dat bare tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD stood firm on dry ground in tha midst of Jordan, N all tha Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all tha people were passed clean over Jordan.

4.text: N it happened, when all tha people were clean passed over Jordan, dat tha LORD spoke 2 Joshua, sayin,
Take u twelve men out of tha people, out of every tribe a man,

N command y’all ’em, sayin, Take u hence out of tha midst of Jordan, out of tha place where tha priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, N y’all shall carry ’em over wit u, N leave ’em in tha lodging place, where y’all shall lodge dis night.
Then Joshua called tha twelve men, whom he had prepared of tha children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

N Joshua said 2 ’em, Pass over before tha ark of tha LORD ur God in2 tha midst of Jordan, N take y’all up every man of u a stone upon his shoulder, according 2 tha number of tha tribes of tha children of Israel:
Dat dis may be a sign among u, dat when ur children ask their fathers in time 2 come, sayin, What mean y’all by dese stones?

Then y’all shall answer ’em, dat tha waterz of Jordan were cut off before tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD; when it passed over Jordan, tha waterz of Jordan were cut off: N dese stones shall be 4 a memorial 2 tha children of Israel 4 ever.

N tha children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, N took up twelve stones out of tha midst of Jordan, as tha LORD spoke 2 Joshua, according 2 tha number of tha tribes of tha children of Israel, N carried ’em over wit ’em 2 tha place where dey lodged, N laid ’em down there.
N Joshua set up twelve stones in tha midst of Jordan, in tha place where tha feet of tha priests which bare tha ark of tha covenant stood: N dey r there 2 dis day.

4 tha priests which bare tha ark stood in tha midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished dat tha LORD commanded Joshua 2 speak 2 tha people, according 2 all dat Moses commanded Joshua: N tha people hasted N passed over.
N it happened, when all tha people were clean passed over, dat tha ark of tha LORD passed over, N tha priests, in tha presence of tha people.
N tha children of Reuben, N tha children of Gad, N half tha tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before tha children of Israel, as Moses spoke 2 ’em:
About forty thousand prepared 4 war passed over before tha LORD 2 battle, 2 tha plains of Jericho.
On dat day tha LORD magnified Joshua in tha sight of all Israel; N dey feared him, as dey feared Moses, all tha days of his life.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Joshua, sayin,
Command tha priests dat bear tha ark of tha testimony, dat dey come up out of Jordan.
Joshua therefore commanded tha priests, sayin, Come y’all up out of Jordan.

N it happened, when tha priests dat bare tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD were come up out of tha midst of Jordan, N tha soles of tha priests’ feet were lifted up 2 tha dry land, dat tha waterz of Jordan returned 2 their place, N flowed over all his banks, as dey did before.
N tha people came up out of Jordan on tha tenth day of tha first month, N encamped in Gilgal, in tha east border of Jericho.
N dose twelve stones, which dey took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
N he spoke 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, When ur children shall ask their fathers in time 2 come, sayin, What mean dese stones?
Then y’all shall let ur children know, sayin, Israel came over dis Jordan on dry land.
4 tha LORD ur God dried up tha waterz of Jordan from before u, until y’all were passed over, as tha LORD ur God did 2 tha Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
Dat all tha people of tha earth might know tha hand of tha LORD, dat it is mighty: dat y’all might fear tha LORD ur God 4 ever.

5.text: N it happened, when all tha kings of tha Amorites, which were on tha side of Jordan westward, N all tha kings of tha Canaanites, which were by tha sea, heard dat tha LORD had dried up tha waterz of Jordan from before tha children of Israel, until we were passed over, dat their heart melted, neither was there spirit in ’em any more, because of tha children of Israel.
At dat time tha LORD said 2 Joshua, Make u sharp knives, N circumcise again tha children of Israel tha second time.
N Joshua made him sharp knives, N circumcised tha children of Israel at tha hill of tha foreskins.
N dis is tha cause why Joshua did circumcise: All tha people dat came out of Egypt, dat were males, even all tha men of war, died in tha wilderness by tha way, after dey came out of Egypt.
Now all tha people dat came out were circumcised: but all tha people dat were born in tha wilderness by tha way as dey came forth out of Egypt, ’em dey had not circumcised.

4 tha children of Israel walked forty years in tha wilderness, till all tha people dat were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because dey obeyed not tha voice of tha LORD: 2 whom tha LORD sware dat he would not show ’em tha land, which tha LORD sware 2 their fathers dat he would give us, a land dat flows wit milk N honey.
N their children, whom he raised up in their stead, ’em Joshua circumcised: 4 dey were uncircumcised, because dey had not circumcised ’em by tha way.
N it happened, when dey had done circumcising all tha people, dat dey stayed in their places in tha camp, till dey were whole.
N tha LORD said 2 Joshua, dis day have I rolled away tha reproach of Egypt from off u. so tha name of tha place is called Gilgal 2 dis day.
N tha children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, N kept tha passover on tha fourteenth day of tha month at even in tha plains of Jericho.
N dey did eat of tha old corn of tha land on tha morrow after tha passover, unleavened cakes, N parched corn in tha selfsame day.
N tha manna ceased on tha morrow after dey had eaten of tha old corn of tha land; neither had tha children of Israel manna any more; but dey did eat of tha fruit of tha land of Canaan dat year.

N it happened, when Joshua was by Jericho, dat he lifted up his eyes N looked, N, look, there stood a man over against him wit his sword drawn in his hand: N Joshua went 2 him, N said 2 him, r u 4 us, or 4 our adversaries?
N he said, no; but as captain of tha host of tha LORD am I now come. N Joshua fell on his face 2 tha earth, N did worship, N said 2 him, What says my lord 2 his servant?
N tha captain of tha LORD’s host said 2 Joshua, Loose ur shoe from off ur foot; 4 tha place whereon u stand is holy. N Joshua did so.

6.text: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of tha children of Israel: none went out, N none came in.
N tha LORD said 2 Joshua, See, I have given in2 thine hand Jericho, N tha king of it, N tha mighty men of valour.
N y’all shall compass tha city, all y’all men of war, N go round about tha city once. like dis will u do six days.
N seven priests shall bear before tha ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: N tha seventh day y’all shall compass tha city seven times, N tha priests shall blow wit tha trumpets.

N it will happen, dat when dey make a long blast wit tha ram’s horn, N when y’all hear tha sound of tha trumpet, all tha people shall shout wit a great shout; N tha wall of tha city shall fall down flat, N tha people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
N Joshua tha son of Nun called tha priests, N said 2 ’em, Take up tha ark of tha covenant, N let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before tha ark of tha LORD.
N he said 2 tha people, Pass on, N compass tha city, N let him dat is armed pass on before tha ark of tha LORD.

N it happened, when Joshua had spoken 2 tha people, dat tha seven priests bearin tha seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before tha LORD, N blew wit tha trumpets: N tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD followed ’em.
N tha armed men went before tha priests dat blew wit tha trumpets, N tha rereward came after tha ark, tha priests goin on, N blowing wit tha trumpets.
N Joshua had commanded tha people, sayin, y’all shall not shout, nor make any noise wit ur voice, neither shall any word proceed out of ur mouth, until tha day I bid u shout; then shall y’all shout.
So tha ark of tha LORD compassed tha city, goin about it once: N dey came in2 tha camp, N lodged in tha camp.
N Joshua rose early in tha morning, N tha priests took up tha ark of tha LORD.

N seven priests bearin seven trumpets of rams’ horns before tha ark of tha LORD went on continually, N blew wit tha trumpets: N tha armed men went before ’em; but tha rereward came after tha ark of tha LORD, tha priests goin on, N blowing wit tha trumpets.
N tha second day dey compassed tha city once, N returned in2 tha camp: so dey did six days.
N it happened on tha seventh day, dat dey rose early about tha dawning of tha day, N compassed tha city after tha same manner seven times: only on dat day dey compassed tha city seven times.
N it happened at tha seventh time, when tha priests blew wit tha trumpets, Joshua said 2 tha people, Shout; 4 tha LORD has given u tha city.
N tha city shall be accursed, even it, N all dat r in it, 2 tha LORD: only Rahab tha harlot shall live, she N all dat r wit her in tha house, because she hid tha messengers dat we sent.
N y’all, in any wise keep y’all from tha accursed thing, lest y’all make y’all accursed, when y’all take of tha accursed thing, N make tha camp of Israel a curse, N trouble it.
But all tha silver, N gold, N vessels of brass N iron, r consecrated 2 tha LORD: dey shall come in2 tha treasury of tha LORD.

So tha people shouted when tha priests blew wit tha trumpets: N it happened, when tha people heard tha sound of tha trumpet, N tha people shouted wit a great shout, dat tha wall fell down flat, so dat tha people went up in2 tha city, every man straight before him, N dey took tha city.
N dey utterly destroyed all dat was in tha city, both man N woman, young N old, N ox, N sheep, N ass, wit tha edge of tha sword.
But Joshua had said 2 tha two men dat had spied out tha country, Go in2 tha harlot’s house, N bring out thence tha woman, N all dat she has, as y’all sware 2 her.
N tha young men dat were spies went in, N brought out Rahab, N her father, N her mother, N her brothers, N all dat she had; N dey brought out all her kindred, N left ’em without tha camp of Israel.
N dey burnt tha city wit fire, N all dat was in it: only tha silver, N tha gold, N tha vessels of brass N of iron, dey put in2 tha treasury of tha house of tha LORD.
N Joshua saved Rahab tha harlot alive, N her father’s household, N all dat she had; N she lives in Israel even 2 dis day; because she hid tha messengers, which Joshua sent 2 spy out Jericho.

N Joshua adjured ’em at dat time, sayin, Cursed be tha man before tha LORD, dat rises up N builds dis city Jericho: he shall lay tha foundation of it in his firstborn, N in his youngest son shall he set up tha gates of it.
So tha LORD was wit Joshua; N his fame was noised throughout all tha country.

7.text: But tha children of Israel committed a trespass in tha accursed thing: 4 Achan, tha son of Carmi, tha son of Zabdi, tha son of Zerah, of tha tribe of Judah, took of tha accursed thing: N tha anger of tha LORD was kindled against tha children of Israel.
N Joshua sent men from Jericho 2 Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on tha east side of Beth-el, N spoke 2 ’em, sayin, Go up N view tha country. N tha men went up N viewed Ai.
N dey returned 2 Joshua, N said 2 him, don’t let all tha people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up N strike Ai; N make not all tha people 2 labour there; 4 dey r but few.
So there went up there of tha people about three thousand men: N dey fled before tha men of Ai.
N tha men of Ai struck of ’em about thirty N six men: 4 dey chased ’em from before tha gate even 2 Shebarim, N struck ’em in tha goin down: so tha hearts of tha people melted, N became as water.
N Joshua rent his clothes, N fell 2 tha earth upon his face before tha ark of tha LORD until tha eventide, he N tha elders of Israel, N put dust upon their heads.

N Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD, so have u at all brought dis people over Jordan, 2 deliver us in2 tha hand of tha Amorites, 2 destroy us? would 2 God we had been content, N lived on tha other side Jordan!
O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turns their backs before their opps!
4 tha Canaanites N all tha inhabitants of tha land shall hear of it, N shall environ us round, N cut off our name from tha earth: N what will u do 2 ur great name?
N tha LORD said 2 Joshua, Get u up; so lie u like dis upon ur face?

Israel has sinned, N dey have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded ’em: 4 dey have even taken of tha accursed thing, N have also stolen, N dissembled also, N dey have put it even among their own stuff.

Therefore tha children of Israel could not stand before their opps, but turned their backs before their opps, because dey were accursed: neither will I be wit u any more, except y’all destroy tha accursed from among u.

Up, sanctify tha people, N say, Sanctify y’all against 2 morrow: 4 like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in tha midst of u, O Israel: u can not stand before thine opps, until y’all take away tha accursed thing from among u.

In tha morning therefore y’all shall be brought according 2 ur tribes: N it will be, dat tha tribe which tha LORD takes shall come according 2 tha families of it; N tha family which tha LORD shall take shall come by households; N tha household which tha LORD shall take shall come man by man.
N it will be, dat he dat is taken wit tha accursed thing shall be burnt wit fire, he N all dat he has: because he has transgressed tha covenant of tha LORD, N because he has wrought folly in Israel.
So Joshua rose up early in tha morning, N brought Israel by their tribes; N tha tribe of Judah was taken:
N he brought tha family of Judah; N he took tha family of tha Zarhites: N he brought tha family of tha Zarhites man by man; N Zabdi was taken:
N he brought his household man by man; N Achan, tha son of Carmi, tha son of Zabdi, tha son of Zerah, of tha tribe of Judah, was taken.
N Joshua said 2 Achan, My son, give, I pray u, glory 2 tha LORD God of Israel, N make confession 2 him; N tell me now what u have done; hide it not from me.
N Achan answered Joshua, N said, Indeed I have sinned against tha LORD God of Israel, N like dis N like dis have I done:

When I saw among tha spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, N two hundred shekels of silver, N a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted ’em, N took ’em; N, look, dey r hid in tha earth in tha midst of my tent, N tha silver under it.
So Joshua sent messengers, N dey ran 2 tha tent; N, look, it was hid in his tent, N tha silver under it.
N dey took ’em out of tha midst of tha tent, N brought ’em 2 Joshua, N 2 all tha children of Israel, N laid ’em out before tha LORD.

N Joshua, N all Israel wit him, took Achan tha son of Zerah, N tha silver, N tha garment, N tha wedge of gold, N his sons, N his daughters, N his oxen, N his asses, N his sheep, N his tent, N all dat he had: N dey brought ’em 2 tha valley of Achor.
N Joshua said, Why have u troubled us? tha LORD shall trouble u dis day. N all Israel stoned him wit stones, N burned ’em wit fire, after dey had stoned ’em wit stones.
N dey raised over him a great heap of stones 2 dis day. So tha LORD turned from tha fierceness of his anger. so tha name of dat place was called, tha valley of Achor, 2 dis day.

8.text: N tha LORD said 2 Joshua, don’t fear, neither be u dismayed: take all tha people of war wit u, N arise, go up 2 Ai: see, I have given in2 ur hand tha king of Ai, N his people, N his city, N his land:
N u will do 2 Ai N her king as u did 2 Jericho N her king: only tha spoil of it, N tha cattle of it, shall y’all take 4 a prey 2 y’all: lay u an ambush 4 tha city behind it.
So Joshua arose, N all tha people of war, 2 go up against Ai: N Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, N sent ’em away by night.
N he commanded ’em, sayin, look, y’all shall lie in wait against tha city, even behind tha city: go not very far from tha city, but be y’all all ready:
N I, N all tha people dat r wit me, will approach 2 tha city: N it will happen, when dey come out against us, as at tha first, dat we will flee before ’em,
(4 dey will come out after us) till we have drawn ’em from tha city; 4 dey will say, dey flee before us, as at tha first: therefore we will flee before ’em.
Then y’all shall rise up from tha ambush, N seize upon tha city: 4 tha LORD ur God will deliver it in2 ur hand.
N it will be, when y’all have taken tha city, dat y’all shall set tha city on fire: according 2 tha commandment of tha LORD shall y’all do. See, I have commanded u.
Joshua therefore sent ’em forth: N dey went 2 lie in ambush, N stayed between Beth-el N Ai, on tha west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged dat night among tha people.
N Joshua rose up early in tha morning, N numbered tha people, N went up, he N tha elders of Israel, before tha people 2 Ai.
N all tha people, even tha people of war dat were wit him, went up, N drew nigh, N came before tha city, N pitched on tha north side of Ai: now there was a valley between ’em N Ai.
N he took about five thousand men, N set ’em 2 lie in ambush between Beth-el N Ai, on tha west side of tha city.
N when dey had set tha people, even all tha host dat was on tha north of tha city, N their liers in wait on tha west of tha city, Joshua went dat night in2 tha midst of tha valley.

N it happened, when tha king of Ai saw it, dat dey hasted N rose up early, N tha men of tha city went out against Israel 2 battle, he N all his people, at a time appointed, before tha plain; but he knew not dat there were liers in ambush against him behind tha city.
N Joshua N all Israel made as if dey were beaten before ’em, N fled by tha way of tha wilderness.
N all tha people dat were in Ai were called together 2 pursue after ’em: N dey pursued after Joshua, N were drawn away from tha city.
N there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, dat went not out after Israel: N dey left tha city open, N pursued after Israel.
N tha LORD said 2 Joshua, Stretch out tha spear dat is in ur hand toward Ai; 4 I will give it in2 thine hand. N Joshua stretched out tha spear dat he had in his hand toward tha city.

10.text: Now it happened, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, N had utterly destroyed it; as he had done 2 Jericho N her king, so he had done 2 Ai N her king; N how tha inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace wit Israel, N were among ’em;

15.text: Dis then was tha lot of tha tribe of tha children of Judah by their families; even 2 tha border of Edom tha wilderness of Zin southward was tha uttermost part of tha south coast.

16.text: N tha lot of tha children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, 2 tha water of Jericho on tha east, 2 tha wilderness dat goes up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,

17.text: There was also a lot 4 tha tribe of Manasseh; 4 he was tha firstborn of Joseph; 2 wit, 4 Machir tha firstborn of Manasseh, tha father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead N Bashan.

But Zelophehad, tha son of Hepher, tha son of Gilead, tha son of Machir, tha son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: N dese r tha namez of his daughters, Mahlah, N Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, N Tirzah.

N dey came near before Eleazar tha priest, N before Joshua tha son of Nun, N before tha princes, sayin, tha LORD commanded Moses 2 give us an inheritance among our brothers. Therefore according 2 tha commandment of tha LORD he gave ’em an inheritance among tha brothers of their father.

N tha coast descended 2 tha river Kanah, southward of tha river: dese citiez of Ephraim r among tha citiez of Manasseh: tha coast of Manasseh also was on tha north side of tha river, N tha outgoings of it were at tha sea:
Southward it was Ephraim’s, N northward it was Manasseh’s, N tha sea is his border; N dey met together in Asher on tha north, N in Issachar on tha east.

N Manasseh had in Issachar N in Asher Beth-shean N her towns, N Ibleam N her towns, N tha inhabitants of Dor N her towns, N tha inhabitants of Endor N her towns, N tha inhabitants of Taanach N her towns, N tha inhabitants of Megiddo N her towns, even three countries.

Yet it happened, when tha children of Israel were waxen strong, dat dey put tha Canaanites 2 tribute; but did not utterly drive ’em out.
N tha children of Joseph spoke 2 Joshua, sayin, Why have u given me but one lot N one portion 2 inherit, seein I am a great people, forasmuch as tha LORD has blessed me until now?

But tha mountain shall be thine; 4 it is a wood, N u will cut it down: N tha outgoings of it shall be thine: 4 u will drive out tha Canaanites, though dey have iron chariots, N though dey be strong.

18.text: N tha whole congregation of tha children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, N set up tha tabernacle of tha congregation there. N tha land was subdued before ’em.

N dey shall divide it in2 seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on tha south, N tha house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on tha north.
y’all shall therefore describe tha land in2 seven parts, N bring tha description here 2 me, dat I may cast lots 4 u here before tha LORD our God.

But tha Levites have no part among u; 4 tha priesthood of tha LORD is their inheritance: N Gad, N Reuben, N half tha tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on tha east, which Moses tha servant of tha LORD gave ’em.

20.text: Tha LORD also spoke 2 Joshua, sayin,
Speak 2 tha children of Israel, sayin, Appoint out 4 u citiez of refuge, whereof I spoke 2 u by tha hand of Moses:

Helkath wit her suburbs, N Rehob wit her suburbs; four citiez.
N out of tha tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee wit her suburbs, 2 be a city of refuge 4 tha slayer; N Hammoth-dor wit her suburbs, N Kartan wit her suburbs; three citiez.
All tha citiez of tha Gershonites according 2 their families were thirteen citiez wit their suburbs.
N 2 tha families of tha children of Merari, tha rest of tha Levites, out of tha tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam wit her suburbs, N Kartah wit her suburbs,
Dimnah wit her suburbs, Nahalal wit her suburbs; four citiez.
N out of tha tribe of Reuben, Bezer wit her suburbs, N Jahazah wit her suburbs,
Kedemoth wit her suburbs, N Mephaath wit her suburbs; four citiez.
N out of tha tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead wit her suburbs, 2 be a city of refuge 4 tha slayer; N Mahanaim wit her suburbs,
Heshbon wit her suburbs, Jazer wit her suburbs; four citiez in all.
So all tha citiez 4 tha children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of tha families of tha Levites, were by their lot twelve citiez.
All tha citiez of tha Levites within tha possession of tha children of Israel were forty N eight citiez wit their suburbs.
Dese citiez were every one wit their suburbs round about ’em: like dis were all dese citiez.
N tha LORD gave 2 Israel all tha land which he sware 2 give 2 their fathers; N dey possessed it, N lived in it.
N tha LORD gave ’em rest round about, according 2 all dat he sware 2 their fathers: N there stood not a man of all their opps before ’em; tha LORD delivered all their opps in2 their hand.
There failed not ought of any good thing which tha LORD had spoken 2 tha house of Israel; all came 2 pass.

22.text: Then Joshua called tha Reubenites, N tha Gadites, N tha half tribe of Manasseh,
N said 2 ’em, y’all have kept all dat Moses tha servant of tha LORD commanded u, N have obeyed my voice in all dat I commanded u:
y’all have not left ur brothers dese many days 2 dis day, but have kept tha charge of tha commandment of tha LORD ur God.

N now tha LORD ur God has given rest 2 ur brothers, as he promised ’em: therefore now return y’all, N get u 2 ur tents, N 2 tha land of ur possession, which Moses tha servant of tha LORD gave u on tha other side Jordan.

But take diligent heed 2 do tha commandment N tha law, which Moses tha servant of tha LORD charged u, 2 love tha LORD ur God, N 2 walk in all his ways, N 2 keep his commandments, N 2 cleave 2 him, N 2 serve him wit all ur heart N wit all ur soul.
So Joshua blessed ’em, N sent ’em away: N dey went 2 their tents.

Now 2 tha one half of tha tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but 2 tha other half of it gave Joshua among their brothers on dis side Jordan westward. N when Joshua sent ’em away also 2 their tents, then he blessed ’em,

N he spoke 2 ’em, sayin, Return wit much riches 2 ur tents, N wit very much cattle, wit silver, N wit gold, N wit brass, N wit iron, N wit very much clothing: divide tha spoil of ur opps wit ur brothers.

N tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad N tha half tribe of Manasseh returned, N departed from tha children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in tha land of Canaan, 2 go 2 tha country of Gilead, 2 tha land of their possession, whereof dey were possessed, according 2 tha word of tha LORD by tha hand of Moses.
N when dey came 2 tha borders of Jordan, dat r in tha land of Canaan, tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad N tha half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar 2 see 2.

N tha children of Israel heard say, look, tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad N tha half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against tha land of Canaan, in tha borders of Jordan, at tha passage of tha children of Israel.
N when tha children of Israel heard of it, tha whole congregation of tha children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, 2 go up 2 war against ’em.
N tha children of Israel sent 2 tha children of Reuben, N 2 tha children of Gad, N 2 tha half tribe of Manasseh, in2 tha land of Gilead, Phinehas tha son of Eleazar tha priest,
N wit him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all tha tribes of Israel; N each one was an head of tha house of their fathers among tha thousands of Israel.
N dey came 2 tha children of Reuben, N 2 tha children of Gad, N 2 tha half tribe of Manasseh, 2 tha land of Gilead, N dey spoke wit ’em, sayin,

Like dis says tha whole congregation of tha LORD, What trespass is dis dat y’all have committed against tha God of Israel, 2 turn away dis day from followin tha LORD, in dat y’all have builded u an altar, dat y’all might rebel dis day against tha LORD?
Is tha iniquity of Peor too little 4 us, from which we r not cleansed until dis day, although there was a plague in tha congregation of tha LORD,
But dat y’all must turn away dis day from followin tha LORD? N it will be, seein y’all rebel 2 day against tha LORD, dat 2 morrow he will be angry wit tha whole congregation of Israel.

Even so, if tha land of ur possession be unclean, then pass y’all over 2 tha land of tha possession of tha LORD, in which tha LORD’s tabernacle lives, N take possession among us: but rebel not against tha LORD, nor rebel against us, in buildin u an altar beside tha altar of tha LORD our God.
Did not Achan tha son of Zerah commit a trespass in tha accursed thing, N wrath fell on all tha congregation of Israel? N dat man perished not alone in his iniquity.
Then tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad N tha half tribe of Manasseh answered, N said 2 tha heads of tha thousands of Israel,
Tha LORD God of gods, tha LORD God of gods, he knows, N Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against tha LORD, (save us not dis day,)
Dat we have built us an altar 2 turn from followin tha LORD, or if 2 offer thereon burnt offering or food offering, or if 2 offer peace offerings thereon, let tha LORD himself require it;
N if we have not rather done it 4 fear of dis thing, sayin, In time 2 come ur children might speak 2 our children, sayin, What have y’all 2 do wit tha LORD God of Israel?
4 tha LORD has made Jordan a border between us N u, y’all children of Reuben N children of Gad; y’all have no part in tha LORD: so shall ur children make our children cease from fearin tha LORD.
Therefore we said, Let us now prepare 2 build us an altar, not 4 burnt offering, nor 4 sacrifice:

But dat it may be a witness between us, N u, N our generations after us, dat we might do tha service of tha LORD before him wit our burnt offerings, N wit our sacrifices, N wit our peace offerings; dat ur children may not say 2 our children in time 2 come, y’all have no part in tha LORD.

Therefore said we, dat it shall be, when dey should so say 2 us or 2 our generations in time 2 come, dat we may say again, look tha pattern of tha altar of tha LORD, which our fathers made, not 4 burnt offerings, nor 4 sacrifices; but it is a witness between us N u.

God forbid dat we should rebel against tha LORD, N turn dis day from followin tha LORD, 2 build an altar 4 burnt offerings, 4 food offerings, or 4 sacrifices, beside tha altar of tha LORD our God dat is before his tabernacle.

N when Phinehas tha priest, N tha princes of tha congregation N heads of tha thousands of Israel which were wit him, heard tha words dat tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad N tha children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased ’em.

N Phinehas tha son of Eleazar tha priest said 2 tha children of Reuben, N 2 tha children of Gad, N 2 tha children of Manasseh, dis day we perceive dat tha LORD is among us, because y’all have not committed dis trespass against tha LORD: now y’all have delivered tha children of Israel out of tha hand of tha LORD.

N Phinehas tha son of Eleazar tha priest, N tha princes, returned from tha children of Reuben, N from tha children of Gad, out of tha land of Gilead, 2 tha land of Canaan, 2 tha children of Israel, N brought ’em word again.
N tha thing pleased tha children of Israel; N tha children of Israel blessed God, N did not intend 2 go up against ’em in battle, 2 destroy tha land in which tha children of Reuben N Gad lived.
N tha children of Reuben N tha children of Gad called tha altar Ed: 4 it shall be a witness between us dat tha LORD is God.

23.text: N it happened a long time after dat tha LORD had given rest 2 Israel from all their opps round about, dat Joshua grew old N stricken in age.
N Joshua called 4 all Israel, N 4 their elders, N 4 their heads, N 4 their judges, N 4 their officers, N said 2 ’em, I am old N stricken in age:
N y’all have seen all dat tha LORD ur God has done 2 all dese nations because of u; 4 tha LORD ur God is he dat has fought 4 u.
Look, I have divided 2 u by lot dese nations dat remain, 2 be an inheritance 4 ur tribes, from Jordan, wit all tha nations dat I have cut off, even 2 tha great sea westward.
N tha LORD ur God, he shall expel ’em from before u, N drive ’em from out of ur sight; N y’all shall possess their land, as tha LORD ur God has promised 2 u.
Be y’all therefore very courageous 2 keep N 2 do all dat is written in tha book of tha law of Moses, dat y’all turn not aside from there 2 tha right hand or 2 tha left;
Dat y’all come not among dese nations, dese dat remain among u; neither make mention of tha name of their gods, nor cause 2 swear by ’em, neither serve ’em, nor bow y’all 2 ’em:
But cleave 2 tha LORD ur God, as y’all have done 2 dis day.
4 tha LORD has driven out from before u great nations N strong: but as 4 u, no man has been able 2 stand before u 2 dis day. …: or, Then tha LORD will drive
One man of u shall chase a thousand: 4 tha LORD ur God, he it is dat fighteth 4 u, as he has promised u.
Take good heed therefore 2 y’all, dat y’all love tha LORD ur God.
Else if y’all do in any wise go back, N cleave 2 tha remnant of dese nations, even dese dat remain among u, N shall make marriages wit ’em, N go in 2 ’em, N dey 2 u:

Know 4 a certainty dat tha LORD ur God will no more drive out any of dese nations from before u; but dey shall be snares N traps 2 u, N scourges in ur sides, N thorns in ur eyes, until y’all perish from off dis good land which tha LORD ur God has given u.

N, look, dis day I am goin tha way of all tha earth: N y’all know in all ur hearts N in all ur souls, dat not one thing has failed of all tha good things which tha LORD ur God spoke concerning u; all r come 2 pass 2 u, N not one thing has failed of it.

Therefore it will happen, dat as all good things r come upon u, which tha LORD ur God promised u; so shall tha LORD bring upon u all evil things, until he have destroyed u from off dis good land which tha LORD ur God has given u.

When y’all have transgressed tha covenant of tha LORD ur God, which he commanded u, N have gone N served other gods, N bowed y’all 2 ’em; then shall tha anger of tha LORD be kindled against u, N y’all shall perish quickly from off tha good land which he has given 2 u.

24.text: N Joshua gathered all tha tribes of Israel 2 Shechem, N called 4 tha elders of Israel, N 4 their heads, N 4 their judges, N 4 their officers; N dey presented themselves before God.

N Joshua said 2 all tha people, like dis says tha LORD God of Israel, ur fathers lived on tha other side of tha flood in old time, even Terah, tha father of Abraham, N tha father of Nachor: N dey served other gods.
N I took ur father Abraham from tha other side of tha flood, N led him throughout all tha land of Canaan, N multiplied his seed, N gave him Isaac.
N I gave 2 Isaac Jacob N Esau: N I gave 2 Esau mount Seir, 2 possess it; but Jacob N his children went down in2 Egypt.
I sent Moses also N Aaron, N I plagued Egypt, according 2 dat which I did among ’em: N afterward I brought u out.
N I brought ur fathers out of Egypt: N y’all came 2 tha sea; N tha Egyptians pursued after ur fathers wit chariots N horsemen 2 tha Red sea.

N when dey cried 2 tha LORD, he put darkness between u N tha Egyptians, N brought tha sea upon ’em, N covered ’em; N ur eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: N y’all lived in tha wilderness a long season.
N I brought u in2 tha land of tha Amorites, which lived on tha other side Jordan; N dey fought wit u: N I gave ’em in2 ur hand, dat y’all might possess their land; N I destroyed ’em from before u.
Then Balak tha son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose N warred against Israel, N sent N called Balaam tha son of Beor 2 curse u:
But I would not listen 2 Balaam; therefore he blessed u still: so I delivered u out of his hand.

N y’all went over Jordan, N came 2 Jericho: N tha men of Jericho fought against u, tha Amorites, N tha Perizzites, N tha Canaanites, N tha Hittites, N tha Girgashites, tha Hivites, N tha Jebusites; N I delivered ’em in2 ur hand.
N I sent tha hornet before u, which drave ’em out from before u, even tha two kings of tha Amorites; but not wit ur sword, nor wit ur bow.
N I have given u a land 4 which y’all did not labour, N citiez which y’all built not, N y’all live in ’em; of tha vineyards N oliveyards which y’all planted not do y’all eat.
Now therefore fear tha LORD, N serve him in sincerity N in truth: N put away tha gods which ur fathers served on tha other side of tha flood, N in Egypt; N serve y’all tha LORD.

N if it seem evil 2 u 2 serve tha LORD, choose u dis day whom y’all will serve; whether tha gods which ur fathers served dat were on tha other side of tha flood, or tha gods of tha Amorites, in whose land y’all live: but as 4 me N my house, we will serve tha LORD.
N tha people answered, God forbid dat we should forsake tha LORD, 2 serve other gods;

4 tha LORD our God, he it is dat brought us up N our fathers out of tha land of Egypt, from tha house of bondage, N which did dose great signs in our sight, N preserved us in all tha way in which we went, N among all tha people through whom we passed:
N tha LORD drave out from before us all tha people, even tha Amorites which lived in tha land: therefore will we also serve tha LORD; 4 he is our God.
N Joshua said 2 tha people, y’all cannot serve tha LORD: 4 he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive ur transgressions nor ur sins.
If y’all forsake tha LORD, N serve strange gods, then he will turn N do u hurt, N consume u, after dat he has done u good.
N tha people said 2 Joshua, no; but we will serve tha LORD.
N Joshua said 2 tha people, y’all r witnesses against y’all dat y’all have chosen u tha LORD, 2 serve him. N dey said, We r witnesses.
Now therefore put away, said he, tha strange gods which r among u, N incline ur heart 2 tha LORD God of Israel.
N tha people said 2 Joshua, tha LORD our God will we serve, N his voice will we obey.
So Joshua made a covenant wit tha people dat day, N set ’em a statute N an ordinance in Shechem.
N Joshua wrote dese words in tha book of tha law of God, N took a great stone, N set it up there under an oak, dat was by tha sanctuary of tha LORD.
N Joshua said 2 all tha people, look, dis stone shall be a witness 2 us; 4 it has heard all tha words of tha LORD which he spoke 2 us: it shall be therefore a witness 2 u, lest y’all deny ur God.
So Joshua let tha people depart, every man 2 his inheritance.
N it happened after dese things, dat Joshua tha son of Nun, tha servant of tha LORD, died, bein an hundred N ten years old.
N dey buried him in tha border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on tha north side of tha hill of Gaash.
N Israel served tha LORD all tha days of Joshua, N all tha days of tha elders dat overlived Joshua, N which had known all tha works of tha LORD, dat he had done 4 Israel.

N tha bones of Joseph, which tha children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried dey in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of tha sons of Hamor tha father of Shechem 4 an hundred pieces of silver: N it became tha inheritance of tha children of Joseph.
N Eleazar tha son of Aaron died; N dey buried him in a hill dat pertained 2 Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
